head: codex/5827-bounded-continuity
title: [v0.92][WP-10] Continuity across bounded cycles
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5827

## Summary
- add deterministic Birthday continuity records and canonical heads bound to verified WP-09 identity authority
- adapt exact signed Runtime v3 LiveContinuity/CheckpointCoordinator manifests, including governed genesis/non-genesis predecessor policy
- reject stale identity records, cross-policy token splicing, discontinuity, substitutions, copied/private paths, provenance/path mismatch, overflow, and tamper
- retain the narrow WP-10 exact-head native macOS/Linux receipt workflow and independent validator

## Validation
- exact crate-internal birthday_continuity nextest lane: 9/9 passed
- compile-fail external policy boundary: 1/1 passed
- strict Clippy, formatting, Ruby producer/validator syntax, typed validation, and diff hygiene: passed
- independent exact-head pre-publication review: approved with no findings
- replacement native macOS/Linux receipts: required from this exact published head before final review and merge

## Scope
This PR does not claim downstream Birthday approval, citizenship, migration, capability-profile, Memory Palace, or metaphysical continuity completion.
